output.title: ACME certificate profiles enable flexible certificate request options
output.content: This change adds support for ACME certificate profiles, allowing users to request different certificate categories (e.g., tlsserver, shortlived) from their ACME CA. The environment uses cert-manager with Certificate resources, indicating ACME-based certificate issuance. This feature is supported by Let's Encrypt and other ACME providers. If you use Let's Encrypt or profile-aware ACME providers, you can now specify certificate profiles in your Certificate resources.
